challenge.solution:
import math
def solve(x, position, theta=10000.0):
    # x has even length; pairwise 2D rotation, frequency theta^(-2i/d)
    d=len(x); out=[0.0]*d
    for i in range(0,d,2):
      freq=theta**(-i/d); a=position*freq; c=math.cos(a); s=math.sin(a)
      out[i]=x[i]*c-x[i+1]*s; out[i+1]=x[i]*s+x[i+1]*c
    return out

challenge.solution:
import math
def solve(x, weight=None, eps=1e-6):
    weight=weight or [1.0]*len(x)
    rms=math.sqrt(sum(v*v for v in x)/len(x)+eps)
    return [v/rms*w for v,w in zip(x,weight)]

import math
def solve(Q,K,V):
    n=len(Q); d=len(Q[0]); out=[]
    for i,q in enumerate(Q):
      scores=[sum(a*b for a,b in zip(q,K[j]))/math.sqrt(d) if j<=i else float("-inf") for j in range(n)]
      m=max(scores); e=[0 if v==float("-inf") else math.exp(v-m) for v in scores]; z=sum(e); p=[v/z for v in e]
      out.append([sum(p[j]*V[j][c] for j in range(n)) for c in range(len(V[0]))])

def solve(position,d_model):
    out=[]
    for i in range(d_model):
      angle=position/(10000**(2*(i//2)/d_model))

challenge.solution:
import math
def solve(Q,K,V,num_query_heads):
    # Each K/V head serves a contiguous group of query heads; tensors are head x seq x dim.
    Hq=len(Q); Hkv=len(K)
    if Hq%Hkv: raise ValueError("query heads must be divisible by KV heads")
    group=Hq//Hkv; out=[]
    for h in range(Hq):
      kh=h//group; headout=[]
      for q in Q[h]:
       scores=[sum(a*b for a,b in zip(q,k))/math.sqrt(len(q)) for k in K[kh]]
       m=max(scores); e=[math.exp(s-m) for s in scores]; z=sum(e); p=[v/z for v in e]
       headout.append([sum(p[t]*V[kh][t][j] for t in range(len(p))) for j in range(len(V[kh][0]))])
      out.append(headout)
    return out
